InvestEd IQ Pro – Learn Investing Daily

Master the art of investing in just 5 minutes a day. InvestEd IQ Pro is a powerful financial education app designed for both beginners and experienced investors. With bite-sized lessons, interactive quizzes, and intelligent tools, learning about money becomes simple, engaging, and effective.

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

Explore comprehensive learning tracks covering stocks, bonds, real estate, portfolio building, cryptocurrency, precious metals, and behavioral finance. Each topic is broken into short, easy-to-understand lessons that fit into your daily routine.

LEARN BY DOING

Every lesson includes interactive questions and real-world scenarios. Practice decision-making, receive instant feedback, and build confidence in applying concepts to real-life situations.

SMART AI ASSISTANT

Chat with FinBot, your personal financial learning assistant. Ask investing-related questions and receive clear, easy-to-understand answers. The app also provides personalized lesson recommendations based on your progress and goals.
*AI responses are for educational purposes only and do not constitute financial advice.*

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS

Earn XP points, maintain daily learning streaks, unlock achievements, and level up as your financial knowledge grows.

COMMUNITY FORUM

Engage with a community of learners. Share insights, ask questions, and discuss topics like stocks, crypto, real estate, and personal finance in a moderated environment.

LEADERBOARD & COMPETITION

Stay motivated by competing on the global leaderboard. Track your progress and challenge yourself to stay consistent.

PORTFOLIO LAB

Build and test investment strategies in a risk-free environment. Understand asset allocation and risk-return tradeoffs without using real money.

PRO SUBSCRIPTION

Upgrade to InvestEd IQ Pro to unlock:

• Unlimited daily lessons
• Unlimited AI chat
• Full forum access
• Leaderboard participation
• Advanced personalized learning features

Subscription options:
• $4.99/month (3-day free trial)
• $44.99/year (3-day free trial)

Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store account settings.

SAFE & PRIVATE

Your data is protected with industry-standard security. We respect your privacy and do not sell your information.

DISCLAIMER

InvestEd IQ is an educational application.
